prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1122; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If you are in contact with any other party or representative regarding this claim, please let us know.

Within ten days of receiving this letter, please provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle repair or total loss records, telematics or event data recorder information, adjuster notes, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Destruction or alteration of such materials could prejudice our client's claim, and we expect that appropriate steps have been taken to secure them.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
